slides: Your muscles don't grow while you lift.

Prioritize recovery and the gains will lift you.

Intent is a spark; outcome is the fire.
The bridge is built one small decision at a time.
Each ignored urge removes a plank.
Keep laying planks and the bridge never collapses.
Morning fatigue is a signal, not a flaw.
Your body is low on glycogen after sleep.
A quick protein‑carb combo resets the engine.
Stabilized blood sugar sustains focus for hours.
Fuel right at rise and the day runs smoother.
Momentum loves a clear direction.
Direction is a line you’ve already drawn.
If the line shifts, momentum stalls.
Align daily actions with that line.
Stay aligned, and the forward push becomes effortless.
